title: Stop praying for a platform your character isn’t built to sustain. 🛑
paragraphs: Stop praying for a platform your character isn’t built to sustain. 🛑
We want the mountaintop view without the valley hike. But God loves you too much to elevate you prematurely. If He gave you the blessing right now, the weight of the responsibility might crush you.
The silent seasons, the unseen grinding, the tests of patience—that isn’t punishment. That’s your training ground. The climb is the preparation.
📖 "Humble yourselves, therefore, under the mighty hand of God so that at the proper time he may exalt you." — 1 Peter 5:6 (ESV)
Are you willing to embrace the preparation season?
